dedupe_keys.name: ireland ntpf public hospital waiting list open data

description: The National Treatment Purchase Fund publishes downloadable CSV tables of people waiting for public-hospital outpatient appointments and inpatient or day-case procedures in Ireland. The provider page groups files by year from 2014 through 2026 and identifies hospital and specialty breakdowns, adult and child analyses, and GI endoscopy lists. The figures are monthly counts of people still waiting, not numbers treated or removed during a month. The provider aggregates groups smaller than 20 into a Small Volume category to reduce identification risk. A GitHub Power BI dashboard led this review to the source, but its 2023 to July 2025 workbook copies are narrower than the maintained NTPF collection and are not the canonical delivery route. The NTPF allows free reuse in any format subject to attribution, accurate reproduction and other stated conditions. This review inspected the provider pages and link list, not the CSV rows, so exact field names and missing months still need checking before modelling. Capacity planners could use the monthly backlog counts to test demand-pressure scenarios, while avoiding the false inference that a change in stock measures treatment throughput. The series covers Irish public hospitals and does not by itself describe individual patient journeys or available beds. Related hospital-bed inventories describe available supply; this waiting-list series describes unresolved demand.
licence: NTPF website re-use terms: free use in any format with source and copyright acknowledgement, accurate reproduction, no misleading use, and no use primarily for product advertising.
